method: Positive two-stage amplitude decays fitted to four Hann-squared weighted power windows, weak rate priors; absolute recorded velocity levels retained.

model_provenance.first_branch_frequency: Measured partial frequency_hz from the locked training feature row.
model_provenance.first_branch_decay: late + extra, positive bounded amplitude decay per second.
model_provenance.late_branch_decay: late, positive bounded amplitude decay per second.
model_provenance.power_model: 0.5 * (F^2 exp(-2 sf t) + L^2 exp(-2 sl t) + 2 F L exp(-(sf+sl)t) cos(2 pi (f_late-f_fast)t))
model_provenance.integration: Carrier-cycle averaged power, weighted by the unchanged four Hann-squared windows using 96 quadrature points per window.
model_provenance.live_model_scope: Default grand notes >=32 use .23-cent late detuning; lower notes use .04 cents. Fitted anchor range MIDI33..84. Outside the measured range and other voicings remain authored extrapolations.
model_provenance.why_no_low_frequency_fit: Only the struck note partial-band powers are fitting targets. Sub-fundamental/subsonic/mains energy has unresolved body, room and acquisition confounds; no hum or low-frequency noise is synthesized to fit it.

limits: One Yamaha C5 / close AB pair. Held-out features excluded. Modal reduction is distinct from the preserved mechanical solver. Upper partials beyond measured bands use negligible authored floors.
